panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of all cores busy, averaged over the scrape interval.

panels.title: GPU
panels.description: GPU active residency.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory in use as a share of installed memory.

panels.title: Thermal state
panels.description: macOS thermal pressure. Above Nominal, the system throttles the CPU and GPU.

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Whole-system power draw.

panels.title: SoC temperature
panels.description: Average SoC die temperature.

panels.title: Swap used
panels.description: Memory paged out to disk. Growth here means memory is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Download
panels.description: All interfaces, received.

panels.title: Upload
panels.description: All interfaces, sent.

panels.title: Disk read
panels.description: All disks.

panels.title: Disk write
panels.description: All disks.

panels.title: Utilization by resource
panels.description: The longest bar is the resource closest to its limit. Swap is its share of the swap currently allocated, which macOS grows on demand.

panels.title: Load, power and heat together
panels.description: Hover to line the series up in time: a CPU or GPU burst should show as power first, then heat, then fan speed.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Super cores are the M5's highest-clocked cores. Performance cores take the rest of the work.

panels.title: Cores now
panels.description: Each core's usage in the latest sample. Cores 0 to 11 are performance cores, 12 to 17 super cores.

panels.title: Cores over time
panels.description: One lane per core. Green is idle, red is saturated. A lane that stays red means one thread is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Power

targets.expr: (mactop_power_watts{component="total"} unless on() mactop_power_watts{component="system"} == 0) - ignoring(component) (mactop_power_watts{component="gpu"} unless on() mactop_power_watts{component="system"} == 0)

panels.description: mactop 2.1.5 reads CPU, DRAM and Neural Engine power as zero on this M5 Pro, so the SoC's share cannot be split further. Samples where those readings spike past the whole-machine reading are left out.

panels.title: Swap
panels.description: macOS allocates swap files as it needs them, so Allocated rising means memory ran short at that moment.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Download above the line, upload below. Samples above 10 GB/s, faster than any link this Mac has, are mactop counter glitches and are left out.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Read above the line, write below.

panels.title: Disk operations
panels.description: Many operations with little throughput means small random I/O.

panels.title: Hottest sensor by area
panels.description: The hottest of each area's sensors.

panels.title: Thermal state
panels.description: Any band other than green is time the Mac spent throttled.
